claim: Distills source material into a compact installable skill package that runs without the original source, names its evidence boundary, and carries output contracts and validation signals.

baseline.prompt: Using notes.md as source, create a skill package at skills/my-distilled-skill/ (SKILL.md and any references) that a future agent could follow without reading notes.md.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure distills the source notes into an installable skill package.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely (open references/source-to-skill-patterns.md), then read notes.md and distill it into an installable skill package at skills/my-distilled-skill/ with SKILL.md (trigger, decision rules, workflow, output contract, failure modes) and any references needed, so a future agent can run the job without reading notes.md. Name the evidence boundary (what notes.md covers, what is unavailable, sensitivity).

tasks.description: Fresh-context baseline (no skill): same task, same package-shape oracle.
tasks.prompt: Using notes.md as source, create a skill package at skills/my-distilled-skill/ (SKILL.md and any references) that a future agent could follow without reading notes.md.
